messages:
hana: heads-up for friday KPI review  our dashboard paid leads spiked but CRM doesn't match. short thread to triage?

jordan: saw that. Looker shows +480 paid regs last 7d, CRM has +330. which tile are you looking at?

hana: marketing.weekly_kpis -> regs by channel (last_7_days) filter=launch_apr.

metrics-bot: nightly ETL complete  looker.dashboard.weekly_kpis refreshed at 06:12 UTC; rows: 4,812

kevin: likely attribution mapping. paid channel relies on gclid->utm mapping in the click-handler. if gclid-only, our pipeline currently maps to "unknown" until gclid decode runs.

tara: and CRM ingest requires email + campaign_source. missing campaign_source will default to "manual" and drop paid attribution.
jordan: can we get quick counts? gclid-only vs utm present?

hana: ran a quick count: gclid-only = 142, utm-present = 338. that's the bulk of the gap.

kevin: propose two quick fixes: (1) temporary: backfill gclid-only as paid for Friday report, (2) long-term: run gclid decoder earlier in pipeline + server-side session pin.
tara: agree. i'll flag the backfill as "informational only" in the deck and add note about CPA impact. we should tell ad-ops.

jordan: @ad-ops FYI please — we may retroactively reassign ~140 regs to paid which will raise last week's CPA. can you prep a short note?

metrics-bot: KPI card updated: "registration attribution variance" added to weekly_kpis by hana at 11:07

hana: thanks. i'll include the numbers and the remediation plan in friday slides. short and transparent. :thumbsup:
